name: VTCode Official
description: Extensions maintained by the VTCode project.

extensions.name: Bitcalc
extensions.description: Arbitrary-width programmer's calculator: any bit width, Verilog-style slices and concatenation, clickable bits and fields.

extensions.name: Hex Editor
extensions.description: Inspect and edit binary files with a hex/ASCII grid, data inspector, search, and undo history.

extensions.name: Waveform Viewer
extensions.description: Explore VCD and FST simulations with a hierarchy browser, digital and analog traces, cursors, markers, transition search, and saved sessions.
